title: Content-Defined Chunk Boundaries
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Content-Defined Chunk Boundaries.
learning_objectives: Explain content-defined chunk boundaries using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for content-defined chunk boundaries
Assess failure and operational limits of content-defined chunk boundaries
concepts_covered: Content-defined chunking chooses boundaries from data content so edits can preserve later chunks better than fixed-size blocks.
ContentDefined uses rolling hash with min/average/max boundaries.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
